entities.name: Chorus of the Conclave
entities.description: Collective mind of dryads that led the Selesnya Conclave before the Decamillennial.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Ravnican guild led by the Chorus.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Vampire whose murder of Savra vod Savo killed the Chorus.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: Event after which the Chorus was killed.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: Source of connection the Selesnya lost.

events.summary: After the Decamillennial the Chorus was killed by Szadek's murder of Savra vod Savo, and Selesnya lost its connection to the World Tree.
events.quote: the Chorus was killed by Szadek 's murder of Savra vod Savo

relations.quote: The guild leader of Selesnya before the Decamillennial was at one point the collective mind of Dryads known as the Chorus of the Conclave
